## Run 6 — SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0, B 0→10 T

Raw Rxx(B) (sr1 50 µV, 10 nA, 50 mT steps to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 = 3 s driver settle/pt). **Read:** clean strong SdH; onset **censored at the 0.30 T analysis edge** (oscillations persist to the lowest usable window — true onset < 0.3 T). Dominant tone **7.1 T = 0.21·F_L** (F_L = 33.1 T, SNR ≈ 40), matching the FS-count model's ABAB **light** pocket (7.31 T at +3.2×10¹², m* 0.027 mₑ; scale 0.97). Higher tones 14.1 / 22.1 / 29.5 T are flagged ≈ 2×/3×/4× of 7.1 — but 22.1 and 29.5 sit 0.8–1.1 T above the exact multiples (21.3 / 28.4) with per-tone δF 1.6–2.4 T, so **this single column cannot distinguish "harmonic comb of the light tone" from "comb + a genuine ABAB heavy pocket near the model's 25.8 T"**. The Luttinger-aware screen forbids dropping them all as harmonics: that leaves Σf = 7.1 ≪ F_L, breaking the partition sum — at least one high tone is a real pocket (or the g = 4 audit fails, its own escalation). No tone at F_L = 33.1 itself: an ABCA singleton is not seen at this density, not yet excluded. Above ~7.5 T the trace enters large QH-scale structure (R → 522 Ω = 10 % FS, no rail); leakage at baseline. **Verdict deferred to the n-trajectory** (investigation Step 4): a k× harmonic tracks k·f_light(n) (3× falls 21.3 → 10.7 T over n = 3.2 → 2.0×10¹²), a real ABAB heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve (model 25.8 → 17.1 T) — a fan separates them decisively even at δF ~ 2 T per column.

"""sdh-spot-check run 6 (electron, n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0 -> 10 T): raw trace, onset, 1/B FFT vs model."""
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

rid, n12 = 6, +3.2                       # run id, density in 1e12 cm^-2 (run-5 cal)
r = run(rid)
o = np.argsort(r.col("magnet_field"))
B, R = r.col("magnet_field")[o], (r.col("sr1_X") / 1 / 10e-9)[o]   # sr1 gain 1, I_bias 10 nA
FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)                          # g = 4, n in m^-2
MODEL = {"ABAB light": 7.31, "ABAB heavy": 25.78, "ABCA": 33.08}   # fs_count_b0 F [T] at +3.2e12

on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
print(on.summary())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(11, 7))
ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ω)", title=f"run {rid} raw — electron spot, n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
# FFT stability set: cutoff above the (censored) onset edge, bg poly deg 5 in B
for co in (0.36, 0.5, 1.0):
    f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(co, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
    ax[1].plot(f, s[0] / s[0].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"cutoff {co:.2f} T")
ax[1].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
for lbl, Fm in MODEL.items():
    ax[1].axvline(Fm, color={"ABAB light": "b", "ABAB heavy": "r", "ABCA": "g"}[lbl], ls=":", label=f"{lbl} {Fm} T")
ax[1].set(xlim=(0, 1.5 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="norm FFT", title="per-cutoff 1/B FFT vs model")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()

f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(0.5, B.max()), bg_degree=5)
sp = s[0]
pk = [i for i in range(2, len(f) - 2) if sp[i] == sp[max(0, i - 3):i + 4].max() and sp[i] > 0.05 * sp.max() and f[i] > 1]
print("peaks at cutoff 0.5 T (F [T], rel amp):",
      [(round(float(f[i]), 2), round(float(sp[i] / sp.max()), 3)) for i in pk])
print(f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T; sum candidates: 7.1+29.5 = {7.1+29.5:.1f} (1.11 F_L), 7.1+25.8(model heavy) = {7.1+25.8:.1f} (0.99 F_L)")

## Run 7 — SdH spot check, hole side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = −1.2×10¹², D = 0, B 10→0.3 T (measured ride-down)

**Read:** oscillatory but **multi-tone and mutually harmonic-confounded** — the investigation's stated near-CNP low-|n| exception regime (model: close, balanced ABAB hole pair 5.3 / 7.1 T, beat-like on short 1/B records; an ABCA hole singleton at this density carries m* ≈ 1 mₑ, LK-dead at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K). Tracked tones 4.7 / 6.6 / 8.5 / 9.4 / 12.3 / 14.8 / 26.2 T with 2×/3×/4× cross-flags in both directions; F_L = 12.4 T; per-tone δF 0.8–1.5 T. No usable partition read, and the hole side is TG-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² at D = 0 — it cannot reach the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² regime where the templates separate. Uninformative for the call, not contradicting it.

**Step-3 verdict → Step 4 (fan design inputs):** the **electron side carries the fan**. Onset < 0.3 T (censored, run 6); fastest credible content ≈ 1.2·F_L(n_max) ≈ 40 T (scale prior) → inherit Δ(1/B) ≤ 0.010; τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB/oct settling floor; sensitivity anchor: run 6 max 522 Ω at n_max, run 7 max 576 Ω at the fan's low-n × high-B corner (|n| = 1.2×10¹², 10 T).

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan` / `landau-fan-vti`), n = +1.2 → +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0.5 → 10 T uniform-1/B

> **05:31** · LF e-side: D=0, n +1.2->+3.2e12 (91 cols), B 0.5->10 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.010 (191 rows), sr1 100 uV, fd 1.8 s (6 tau), sd 1 s; ends 10 T, gates park 0 · **ETA ~17:31** (≈12h)

**Why now (investigation Step 4, fan on the cleaner side):** run 6 (electron, ana) resolved a strong light tone at 7.1 T = 0.21·F_L matching the model ABAB light pocket (7.31 T), plus high tones {14.1, 22.1, 29.5 T} that a single column cannot split between "harmonic comb of 7.1" and "comb + genuine ABAB heavy pocket (model 25.8 T)" — per-tone δF is 1.6–2.4 T there. The n-trajectory decides: 3×f_light falls 21.3 → 10.7 T over n = 3.2 → 2.0×10¹² while a real heavy pocket follows 25.8 → 17.1 T, and an ABCA singleton would ride F_L itself. Run 7 (hole) is the near-CNP exception regime, TG-limited to |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹² — uninformative; **coverage trade:** the hole side is excluded from the fan (an ~11 h hole fan cannot reach the |n| ≳ 2×10¹² template-separation regime at D = 0; its price stays on the table if the electron read forks).

**Design (both Nyquist checks computed, not inherited):** B-axis uniform in 1/B, Δ(1/B) = 0.010 → **191 rows**, Nyquist ×2.5 on the fastest credible content 40 T (= 1.2·F_L(n_max), scale prior; ×3.4 on the observed 29.5 T). B_lo = 0.5 T: run-6 onset is censored < 0.3 T so 0.5 T rows carry signal; 0.5 T is the floor set by the ≥5-period partner-tone rule — (1/0.5 − 1/10) = 1.9 ≥ 5/f_light(n) for n ≥ 2.0×10¹², the partition-claim window; columns 1.2–2.0×10¹² track the heavy/singleton trajectory where template contrast is largest. B_max = 10 T (session cap): heavy-tone δF = 1/(1/1.6 − 1/10) ≈ 1.9 T, plus the ν = 12, 16 LL-ladder corner for the adjacent-N complement. n-axis: **91 columns** over 2×10¹² → 2.2 samples per ray spacing at 0.5 T (floor ≥ 2). Sensitivity **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS**: worst corner (low n × high B) anchored by run 7's 576 Ω at |n| = 1.2×10¹², 10 T → ~17× headroom; SdH amplitudes 30–120 Ω = 0.3–1.2 % FS (run 6 had SNR 40–90 at 2× finer scale — budget holds, clipping is the asymmetric failure). Dwell: fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct — per-column-FFT discipline), slow_delay 1 s.

**Price (calibrated in-session):** per-point 1.9 s (run 5: median dt 1.098 s at fast_delay 1.0 → reads ≈ 0.10 s), rows 191 × 91 pts = 9.2 h + row turnaround (flyback + settle 3 s/row, run-6-confirmed) 0.3 h + 9.5 T in-fan ramp at 0.137 T/min = 1.16 h + positioning ≈ **10.8 h computed**; headline 12 h (session actuals ran 5–10 % over upper estimates). **Ends at 10 T with gates parked at 0** — the next measurement (LK mass split or a firming fan) rides the magnet down, never re-traversing.

**E1 / checkpoints:** all swept/set values inside the committed validators (Vtg ≤ 0.984, Vbg ≤ 1.166 V, B ≤ 10 T = cap); guard trips interrupt on |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 2 K. First-rows checkpoint at ~20 min (rail/leak/T/row cadence vs plan), then ~2-hourly partial per-column FFT reads on the landed rows — wash-out call if columns show no tone structure above noise by ~5 T. Abort = kernel interrupt; magnet holds at current field.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): n = +1.2 -> +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.5 -> 10 T uniform-1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.2, 91)            # fast axis, 1e12 cm^-2 — each row starts at the run-6 spot
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)                    # D = 0 line
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 (91 cols), Vtg {Vtgs.max():+.4f}..{Vtgs.min():+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs.max():+.4f}..{Vbgs.min():+.4f} V")

# --- field axis: uniform in 1/B, Delta(1/B) = 0.010 (Nyquist x2.5 on 40 T = 1.2x scale-prior F_L(n_max)) ---
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1 / 0.5, 1 / 10.0, 191)      # 0.5 -> 10 T ascending, 191 rows
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"B: {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {len(B_vec)} rows, d(1/B) = {(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1])/(len(B_vec)-1):.4f} 1/T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, "
      f"output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0         # 6*tau per-column-FFT dwell; gates retrace during slow_delay
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)                    # 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA: run-7 corner anchor 576 Ohm at |n|=1.2e12, 10 T
_tau = sr1.time_constant()
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-3, f"tau changed on the front panel: {_tau} s"
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {_tau} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; "
      f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s = 6 tau; sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan electron side: n = +1.2..+3.2e12 (91) at D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  "B 0.5 -> 10 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.010 (191), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau)")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0.00 V/nm: n = +1.20 to +3.20e12 cm^-2 (91-col paired n-line), '
              f'B = 0.5 to 10 T uniform-1/B d(1/B)=0.010 (191 rows); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; '
              f'follows sdh-spot-check runs 6 (electron, fan side) / 7 (hole)')

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def run_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, t_s = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP or t_s > T_TRIP:
        print(f"GUARD TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e} A, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A, T={t_s:.2f} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(run_guard, ())

magnet.field(B_vec[0])                     # blocking positioning ramp 0 -> 0.5 T (~4 min); the set call is the settle
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    # field left at 10 T deliberately — the next measurement rides it down (never re-traverse)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked 0/0, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
